actualFamilyAnchors.actualAlgorithm: Calculates an invoice total from a subtotal, discount percentage, and sales tax percentage. The discount amount is stored in PIC 9(5)V99 without ROUNDED (truncating fractional cents toward zero), subtracted from the subtotal to yield the net amount, and taxed using COMPUTE TAX-AMT ROUNDED (half-up to 2 decimal places) before adding net and tax.

Computes a pro-rata subscription charge from an annual fee, days used, and a promotional credit. The annual fee is divided by 365 into an intermediate 4-decimal field (PIC 9(3)V9(4)) with ROUNDED, multiplied by days used into a 2-decimal gross charge field (PIC 9(5)V99) with ROUNDED (which truncates any sixth integer digit modulo 100000.00 when the rounded product reaches 100000.00), and reduced by the credit amount with a floor at 0.00.

Performs a triangulated foreign-exchange conversion from a base currency amount using two sequential 4-decimal rates and a fixed settlement wire fee. The intermediate amount MID-AMT is stored in PIC 9(6)V9(4) without ROUNDED (truncating fractional digits beyond scale 4 toward zero), multiplied by the second rate into SETTLE-AMT PIC 9(6)V99 with ROUNDED (half-up to scale 2), and reduced by WIRE-FEE.

Computes the weighted average unit inventory cost across two purchase lots. Each lot's quantity (PIC 9(3)) and unit cost (PIC 9(3)V99) are multiplied into exact 2-decimal extended cost fields (EXT-1 and EXT-2, PIC 9(6)V99), the quantities are summed into TOT-QTY (PIC 9(4)), and the combined extended cost is divided by TOT-QTY into UNIT-AVG (PIC 9(4)V99) using ROUNDED (half-up to 2 decimal places).

Computes a two-period compounded interest balance from an initial principal and two quarterly percentage rates. Period 1 interest (INT-1, PIC 9(5)V99) is computed without ROUNDED (truncating fractional cents toward zero) and added to PRINCIPAL to form BAL-1 (PIC 9(6)V99). Period 2 interest (INT-2, PIC 9(6)V99) is computed on BAL-1 with ROUNDED (half-up to 2 decimal places) and added to BAL-1 to produce BAL-2.

Updates an account balance by adding a signed adjustment (ADJ-AMT, PIC S9(5)) to an opening balance (START-BAL, PIC 9(5)) into an unsigned intermediate balance field (MID-BAL, PIC 9(5)), which strips the negative sign (coercing negative intermediate sums to their positive absolute magnitude), and then subtracts a signed fee (FEE-AMT, PIC S9(4)) into a signed final balance (END-BAL, PIC S9(6)).
